title: Whose Light Remains
author: The local archive of {city_name}
text: You're a Milewarden, aren't you? Perhaps you can settle an argument. We pass a lamp from house to house, but the inscription in {dungeon_name} may tell a different story. Read our ledger before you go, then bring me the words you find there.
ledger_prompt: Copy the lamp account from the town book in {city_name} before setting out.
inscription: The keeper who tends this lamp owns it. After the keeper departs, the lamp passes to the next keeper as their own property.
finding: Here the lamp is borrowed. There it belongs to whoever tends it. The two places kept different customs.
completion: So they called it their own. My grandmother would have had words with them. I'll keep your copy beside ours. Let the next reader see both.
